messages.text: Map the chain from a Semiconductor market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

已查到可引用的部分資料：

The supported chain is partial: the passages connect AI-server semiconductor power demand to PDN/interface test contexts where scopes are used, but they do not specify an oscilloscope model, bandwidth, sample rate, data-rate coverage, option code, or pass/fail limit [4][5][13][60].
| Semiconductor market requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Oscilloscope capability supported by the passages | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI servers pull PMIC demand as chip count scales, and the PMIC driver is increasing GPU count and memory modules [5]. | PMICs handle last-mile chip power distribution, voltage regulation, and over-current protection, so the supported measurement context is power-delivery / PDN validation [6][13]. | The passages state that Power Distribution Network testing is associated with scopes and network analyzers [13][60]. | The passages do not provide a PDN impedance target value, oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, or test method [13]. |
| AI servers pull power-semiconductor demand through power-architecture upgrades, and the stated driver is 800V high-voltage architecture specification improvement [5]. | Power semiconductors perform high-current conversion and switching to step external power down into racks [6]. | The supported oscilloscope role is again PDN-related observation because the PDN test block is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [13][60]. | The passages do not provide a scope specification for 800V / HVDC validation, nor do they give a formal test standard or configuration [13][50]. |
| High-speed electrical-interface validation is a semiconductor test context covering Tx, Rx, channel, packages, PCBs, connectors, EQ, ADC + DSP, and DSP + DAC [60]. | The measurable SI items explicitly listed are IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [60]. | The passages map Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [13][60]. | The passages do not provide oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, standard version, software option, or pass/fail condition [13][14]. |
【推論】For AI-server PMIC / power-semiconductor demand, the defensible oscilloscope capability requirement is “support PDN / power-integrity measurement workflows,” because the passages tie AI-server demand to PMIC and power semiconductors, and separately tie PDN testing to scopes [5][6][13][60].
【推論】For high-speed semiconductor interface demand, the defensible oscilloscope capability requirement is “support interface-test workflows including waveform / eye-diagram-oriented validation,” because the passages tie Interface Test to scopes and list Eye diagram among SI-flow items [13][60].

IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 5 › 重點摘要
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 5]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）是一張硬體架構方塊圖 / 資料流方塊圖，描述一個運算加速器的外部 I/O、資料緩衝、控制邏輯與計算單元。
- 圖上沒有座標軸，也不是市場趨勢圖、時間序列圖或統計比較圖；主要數字單位為 **GiB/s** 與 **per cycle**。
- 圖上外部連接包含 **PCIe Gen3 ×16 Interface** 與 **Host Interface**；外部 I/O 與 Host Interface 相關路徑標示 **14 GiB/s**。
- 圖上記憶體 / 權重輸入路徑包含 **DDR3 DRAM Chips**、**DDR3-2133 Interfaces** 與 **Weight FIFO (Weight Fetcher)**，相關頻寬標示 **30 GiB/s**。
- 圖上中央資料緩衝為 **Unified Buffer (Local Activation Storage)**，Host Interface 到 Unified Buffer 的資料通道標示 **10 GiB/s**。
- 圖上 **Systolic Data Setup** 到右側計算單元的資料通道標示 **167 GiB/s**；下方回到 Unified Buffer 的藍色資料路徑也標示 **167 GiB/s**。
- 圖上核心計算模組是 **Matrix Multiply Unit (64K per cycle)**，其後接 **Accumulators**、**Activation** 與 **Normalize/Pool**。
- 圖上多個紅色方塊標示 **Control**，左下有 **Instr**，來源文字解讀為控制訊號與指令模組協調整個系統。

| AI servers pull power-semiconductor demand through power-architecture upgrades, and the stated driver is 800V high-voltage architecture specification improvement [5]. | Power semiconductors perform high-current conversion and switching to step external power down into racks [6]. | The supported oscilloscope role is again PDN-related observation because the PDN test block is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [13][60]. | The passages do not provide a scope specification for 800V / HVDC validation, nor do they give a formal test standard or configuration [13][50]. |
| High-speed electrical-interface validation is a semiconductor test context covering Tx, Rx, channel, packages, PCBs, connectors, EQ, ADC + DSP, and DSP + DAC [60]. | The measurable SI items explicitly listed are IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [60]. | The passages map Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [13][60]. | The passages do not provide oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, standard version, software option, or pass/fail condition [13][14]. |
【推論】For AI-server PMIC / power-semiconductor demand, the defensible oscilloscope capability requirement is “support PDN / power-integrity measurement workflows,” because the passages tie AI-server demand to PMIC and power semiconductors, and separately tie PDN testing to scopes [5][6][13][60].
【推論】For high-speed semiconductor interface demand, the defensible oscilloscope capability requirement is “support interface-test workflows including waveform / eye-diagram-oriented validation,” because the passages tie Interface Test to scopes and list Eye diagram among SI-flow items [13][60].
